heading.en: Cancel the wrong, record the right

hook.en: An accountant never uses an eraser. Errors are corrected by passing a fresh journal entry.

objectives.en: Pass rectifying entries for two-sided errors.
Use the three-step method: wrong entry, correct entry, rectifying entry.

narration.en: An accountant never uses an eraser. Errors are corrected by passing a fresh journal entry.
narration.kn: ಲೆಕ್ಕಿಗರು ಎಂದಿಗೂ ರಬ್ಬರ್ ಬಳಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ತಪ್ಪುಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಸ ಜರ್ನಲ್ ನಮೂದಿನ ಮೂಲಕ ತಿದ್ದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: Step 1: write the entry that was actually (wrongly) passed. Step 2: write the entry that should have been passed. Step 3: debit the account that was wrongly credited or not debited enough, and credit the account that was wrongly debited or not credited enough. Two-sided errors are always corrected by a full journal entry between the two accounts.

narration.kn: ಮೂರು ಹಂತದ ವಿಧಾನ: ಆಗಿರುವ ತಪ್ಪು ನಮೂದು ಬರೆಯಿರಿ, ಸರಿಯಾದ ನಮೂದು ಬರೆಯಿರಿ, ನಂತರ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸವನ್ನು ಸರಿಪಡಿಸುವ ತಿದ್ದುಪಡಿ ನಮೂದು ಹಾಕಿರಿ.

title.en: On the board: Rectifying two-sided errors

say.en: Three steps: what was done, what should have been done, then the entry that bridges the two.
Furniture debited to purchases: debit furniture, credit purchases with 10,000.
Credit sale to Kiran not recorded: nothing to cancel, so pass the full entry.
Cash from Arun credited to Varun: debit Varun to cancel, credit Arun to correct.
Check with T accounts: purchases was debited 10,000 wrongly; the credit cancels it.

problem.en: Pass rectifying entries: (i) Furniture bought for ₹10,000 was debited to the purchases account. (ii) A credit sale of ₹4,000 to Kiran was not recorded at all. (iii) Cash ₹3,000 received from Arun was credited to Varun's account.

steps.en: (i) Wrong: Purchases Dr 10,000. Correct: Furniture Dr 10,000. Rectify: Furniture A/c Dr ₹10,000 To Purchases A/c ₹10,000.
(ii) Nothing was recorded, so pass the full entry: Kiran A/c Dr ₹4,000 To Sales A/c ₹4,000.
(iii) Wrong: credited Varun. Correct: credit Arun. Rectify: Varun A/c Dr ₹3,000 To Arun A/c ₹3,000.

answer.en: Furniture Dr / Purchases Cr ₹10,000; Kiran Dr / Sales Cr ₹4,000; Varun Dr / Arun Cr ₹3,000.

points.en: Errors of principle move the amount between capital and revenue accounts.
points.kn: ತತ್ವದ ತಪ್ಪುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮೊತ್ತವನ್ನು ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಮತ್ತು ಆದಾಯ ಖಾತೆಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ವರ್ಗಾಯಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

homework.en: Rectify: goods of ₹2,500 taken by the proprietor for personal use were not recorded.

narration.en: Recap. Two-sided errors are rectified by a journal entry between the two accounts. Write the wrong entry, the correct entry, then the difference. Errors of principle move the amount between capital and revenue accounts.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಎರಡು ಬದಿಯ ತಪ್ಪುಗಳನ್ನು ಎರಡು ಖಾತೆಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಜರ್ನಲ್ ನಮೂದಿನಿಂದ ತಿದ್ದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ತಪ್ಪು ನಮೂದು, ಸರಿಯಾದ ನಮೂದು, ನಂತರ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ ಬರೆಯಿರಿ. ತತ್ವದ ತಪ್ಪುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮೊತ್ತವನ್ನು ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಮತ್ತು ಆದಾಯ ಖಾತೆಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ವರ್ಗಾಯಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
